description: Start here for any neighborhood or trend question. Pass city and place, such as Milwaukee and Harbor View. Returns counts by crime type versus the city, counts by month, noon-to-midnight share, top streets, and a few notable incidents. One call covers up to 450 days. A lat/lon box is optional. Do not download citywide incidents and filter them yourself.

days.description: Days ending at the newest incident in the city. Default 90. Use 400 for about 14 months.

lat_max.description: North edge of the box. Geographic filter.

lat_min.description: South edge of the box. Geographic filter.

lon_max.description: East edge of the box. Geographic filter.

lon_min.description: West edge of the box. Geographic filter.

place.description: Neighborhood or rough area, such as Harbor View or Logan Square. Omit if you pass a box.

name: get_area_trends
